briefs.working_title: Sourdough Bread Recipe for Beginners, Step by Step
briefs.meta_description: The sourdough loaf we bake every day, written for first-time bakers: clear timings, photos of each stage and fixes for common problems.
briefs.summary: This is the largest recipe topic in the list: 5 keywords with 68,500 monthly searches between them, led by "sourdough bread recipe" at 40,500. Average difficulty is 51.8, so it will take a strong page to compete. A page already exists for it, so this is a rewrite, not a new post.
briefs.search_intent: The searcher wants to bake a loaf at home and needs a recipe they can follow start to finish. Several of the 5 keywords add "easy" or "for beginners", so many of them have not baked sourdough before and want reassurance as much as instructions.
briefs.audience: Home bakers making their first or second sourdough loaf. They own basic kitchen equipment and may not have a starter yet.
briefs.angle: Written by the bakers who make this loaf for the shop every morning. Lead with what a professional watches for at each stage, and what to do when it goes wrong, which generic recipes skip.
questions_to_answer: How do I make sourdough bread from start to finish?

briefs.search_intent: Most searchers want a recipe to bake at home. A smaller share are looking to buy: "cinnamon rolls near me" has 4,400 monthly searches, so the page should also make it easy to find the shop.

briefs.angle: The overnight method is the hook: mix and shape in the evening, bake fresh in the morning. Include the shop's own glaze.

briefs.search_intent: The searcher needs a birthday cake soon and wants to know three things quickly: can I get one near me, can it be delivered or ordered online, and can it be customized. The 4 keywords cover exactly those needs.
briefs.audience: Local customers organizing a birthday, often at short notice. They are comparing bakeries, not looking for something to read.
briefs.angle: This is a sales page, not an article. Answer the practical questions first and make ordering the obvious next step.
